Dimensional is the agentic operating system for generalist robotics.

The team is from MIT, CMU, Cornell, DJI, Figure, and has raised $200M+ for previous projects. Backed by the head of Apple Robotics, CEO of HuggingFace, cofounder of GoogleX, CTO of Windsurf, and more.

We launched recently and hit #3 trending on Github. Thousands of developers are now using Dimensional to program physical space.

We’re looking for relentless hackers across Software, Infra, Manipulation, Navigation, and LLM/Agents to join us in SF/Shenzhen to power the next generation of agentive robotics.
